name: Zap Capital Aero Data
description: Read-only machine discovery card for Zap Capital's free daily Base Aero dataset (top 50 pools: on-chain Allocation Power, 24h mean fee rate vs spot, 24h swap volume, estimated gross swap fees, TVL, and weekly AERO emission caps). Static HTTPS endpoints described in https://docs.zap.capital/openapi.json; no API key required.

skills.name: Base Aero Daily Pool & Gauge Snapshot
skills.description: Retrieve the daily Base Aero snapshot (JSON/CSV/Schema/Index) for top 50 pools by Allocation Power, with verified pool/gauge/voting-rewards addresses, 24h time-weighted fee_pct, volume_24h_usd, gross_swap_fees_24h_usd_est, and TVL. OpenAPI spec: https://docs.zap.capital/openapi.json.
